fluff.overview:
The Dragon Fire traces its origins to the twenty-eighth century, conceived as part of the same development project that produced the legendary Marauder. Despite promising specifications, the design never progressed beyond the drawing board during the Star League era, remaining a footnote in General Motors' archives for centuries. The rediscovery of lost Star League technical data in the mid-3050s breathed new life into the dormant blueprint, and General Motors licensed production to J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated rather than undertake the project themselves.

The first Dragon Fire rolled off JBBMI's production lines on Storfors in late 3058, and the seventy-five-ton heavy 'Mech quickly attracted attention from multiple Great Houses. The Dragon Fire established a reputation as a resilient and versatile fire support platform, though corporate upheaval and the Jihad dramatically altered the design's trajectory before new manufacturers eventually restored it to prominence across the Inner Sphere.
fluff.capabilities:
The Dragon Fire delivers formidable firepower through a carefully balanced weapons array enabled by its Pitban 300 XL engine and Royalstar endo steel chassis. The Zeus Slingshot Gauss rifle serves as the primary weapon, delivering devastating kinetic impacts at extreme range without generating waste heat. A Mydron Excel LB 10-X autocannon complements the Gauss rifle with versatile ammunition options, capable of firing both standard slugs for concentrated damage and cluster rounds effective against vehicles and aerospace fighters. An ExoStar large laser provides reliable energy-based firepower independent of ammunition supplies, while twin Defiance B4M medium pulse lasers deliver accurate close-range fire.

Fourteen and a half tons of ArcShield Maxi II armor provide substantial protection for a heavy 'Mech, and CASE mitigates the risk posed by the design's considerable ammunition stores. The Guardian ECM suite disrupts enemy targeting and electronic warfare systems, a valuable capability that distinguishes the Dragon Fire from many of its contemporaries. The design's primary limitations stem from its reliance on an XL engine, which leaves it vulnerable to side torso damage, and its complete lack of jump jets, restricting maneuverability in rough terrain. The Dragon Fire also bears the dubious distinction of being considered one of the aesthetically least appealing BattleMechs in service, its unsightly weapon bulges and sensor arrays marring the Marauder family's otherwise sleek lines.
fluff.history:
The Dragon Fire's existence spans centuries of unrealized potential followed by decades of turbulent production history. Originally designed in the late twenty-eighth century alongside the Marauder, the Dragon Fire never achieved production during the Star League era, its blueprints languishing in General Motors' archives through the Succession Wars. The recovery of the Gray Death Memory Core in 3054 brought the design back into consideration, and GM licensed the project to J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated on Storfors for a token fee rather than diverting their own production resources.

The first Dragon Fires entered service in late 3058 and immediately proved their worth. The Draconis Combine became JBBMI's primary customer, and Lyran standing orders reflected unusual cross-faction demand driven by the shared Clan threat. The design's advanced arsenal offered a genuine answer to Clan technology advantages, and its performance during Operation Bulldog and the subsequent Great Refusal cemented its reputation among Inner Sphere militaries.

The mid-3060s brought a dramatic shift when JBBMI signed an exclusive subsidiary contract with the Word of Blake, redesigning the Dragon Fire with improved C-cubed technology. In 3068, a financial crisis saw the company change hands as Blakist-affiliated stockholders acquired controlling interest. Production facilities across the Alliance, Combine, and Federated Suns were shuttered, with new plants opening on Epsilon Eridani, Caph, and New Earth under the renamed J.B. BattleMechs of the Protectorate Ltd. The Dragon Fire became closely associated with the Word of Blake Militia, though a daring raid on the Myer facility on New Earth by Skye Ranger forces resulted in at least six machines being liberated.

The Jihad devastated JBBMI's reputation beyond recovery, and the Dragon Fire spent decades in obscurity following the conflict. The design's fortunes reversed during the Dark Age when General Motors finally took direct interest, producing the radically redesigned DGR-9D as a pocket assault 'Mech from their Kathil facilities. Independence Weaponry on Quentin leveraged their experience with the Fujin to produce the DGR-7K for the Draconis Combine. During the fighting over the Dragon's Tongue, Dragon Fires were fielded in strength by both Houses Davion and Kurita, marking the design's definitive return to frontline service.

The Dragon Fire's combat record includes notable engagements such as Operation Solar Flare, where Davion Assault Guards deployed their Dragon Fires against the mercenary unit Ravannion's Redemption off Euclid. The ensuing engagement saw Davion and Draconis-built Dragon Fires on opposite sides, with the mercenaries' ballistic-reinforced armor variants proving surprisingly effective against the Guards' superior firepower. Persistent rumors from the spinward Periphery describe a nightmarish machine resembling a warped Marauder, speculated to be a heavily modified Dragon Fire, though such reports remain unconfirmed.
fluff.deployment: General Motors' complete reimagining of the Dragon Fire emerged during the Dark Age as a pocket assault 'Mech, trading the original's mobility for devastating firepower. The engine was downgraded to a Pitban 225 XL, reducing top speed to just fifty-four kilometers per hour, while GM MAD DF endo-composite internals and an XL gyroscope freed tonnage for an impressive weapons array. The retained Zeus Slingshot Gauss rifle is complemented by a Mydron Tornado rotary autocannon and a suite of ExoStar Pinnacle Clan-specification energy weapons including an ER PPC, ER large laser, and paired ER medium lasers. Valiant Lamellor standard armor provides maximum protection for the chassis weight, with CASE II guarding against ammunition explosions. Manufactured at Kathil, Quentin, and Storfors, the 9D has seen service primarily with the Federated Suns and Draconis Combine during the Dragon's Tongue campaigns.
